settings.title: Sizing help, breed by breed
settings.text: Every size button has a guide beside it, and the Sleep Match gives you a size in 60 seconds.

settings.question: How do I choose the right size?
settings.answer: Measure your pet from nose to base of tail while they're stretched out asleep, then add 15–20cm. Curlers can size down; sprawlers should size up. The Sleep Match gives you a size to look for in 60 seconds.

settings.question: Which sleep need is right for my pet?
settings.answer: Calm for nervous nappers who like a wall at their back. Support for older joints and bigger dogs. Cosy for curlers, burrowers and cats. Stretch for flat-out sprawlers. Cool for pets who run hot.
